name: vidbyte-memory
description: Correction-driven memory for coding agents: every correction becomes a fact, a test and a footprint commit in your repo. No API key, no database, no service.

interface.shortDescription: Memory that learns from your corrections, enforced by tests.
interface.longDescription: Each time you correct the agent, the correction becomes a slim fact or rule it loads next time, a pytest test or verifier that fails if the mistake comes back, and a footprint commit that records how memory changed. Everything lives as markdown, tests and git in your own repo: no API key, no database, no service. Ask Codex to install vidbyte-memory in a repo and the install-memory skill sets it up, including a Stop hook that keeps the turn going while tests fail, feedback is pending or memory is uncommitted.
